global_qa_observations:
**Trustpilot pagination instability:** Trustpilot page numbers (the ?page=N parameter) are dynamic and change as reviews are added or removed. Reviews confirmed on page 4 or 5 during subagent access may appear on different page numbers in subsequent accesses. The review content is persistent on Trustpilot but the page-level URL is not stable over time.

**Buyer-voice vs. seller-voice filtering:** Of approximately 125–128 total Trustpilot reviews for lemonsqueezy.com, the substantial majority are seller-voice (sellers describing their experience using Lemon Squeezy as a selling platform). Approximately 16–20 reviews within the time window are buyer-voice (people who purchased products through Lemon Squeezy checkout). The buyer-speaker test was applied strictly: "Sellers report buyers do X" content was excluded per D4 direction rules.

**Aggregate data incompleteness:** All traffic analytics findings (Semrush, SimilarWeb, Google Trends) were moved to Part 4 per the direction-specific rule requiring source AND sample AND period for aggregate data. All had source and period but none disclosed sample size or methodology on their free-tier pages.

**Systematic absence across non-Trustpilot platforms:** Buyer-voice content about Lemon Squeezy is absent from Reddit (all tested subreddits), Hacker News, YouTube, Twitter/X, G2, Capterra, and Sitejabber within the time window. This consistent absence across multiple independent platforms is documented in F-X07 through F-X15.

**Snippet fidelity for non-English characters:** Some Trustpilot reviews contain special characters (€, curly quotes, ellipsis characters). Snippets preserve these as they appeared in the rendered page text. HTML entity encoding (e.g., &#x27;) was converted to the displayed character.
